article.title: Nosso, nossa, nossos y nossas
article.part: Artículos, determinantes y cuantificación — Artigos, determinantes e quantificação
article.chapter: Determinantes, demostrativos y cuantificación — Determinantes, demonstrativos e quantificação

claims.sectionKey: Nosso, nossa, nossos y nossas son posesivos de primera persona plural
claims.summary: These demonstrative pronouns are used by the first person plural and refer to a group that includes the speaker and agrees with the possessed noun.

claims.sectionKey: Las formas varían en género y número con el elemento poseído
claims.summary: The four forms of the possessive pronouns vary in gender and number according to the possessed noun.

links.notes: The source explicitly states that 'nosso, nossa, nossos, e nossas' are possessive pronouns used by the first person plural, agreeing with the gender and number of the possessed noun.
The source provides examples of the possessive pronouns agreeing with the gender and number of the possessed noun, such as 'nossa casa' (feminine singular) and 'nossos livros' (masculine plural).
